name: Rope L2 balanced transfer trolley
description: One low battery balances rear M and front L drives. Four identical PLA bearing arches carry four large landing tyres and the cord axles; the front crown has bearings on both faces. The L motor is held by four pins and its shaft has a positive stop. Two paired-rubber cord channels guide the trolley, two chains power the front deck tyres, and passive large rear tyres clear the final step. A raised receiver and a brick cable keeper route the battery lead above the saddles.

motor_program.note: Transfer torque at both deck corners.
Slow after the rear wheels have climbed onto the goal deck.
Park on the goal deck and hold.
